summary: Make all docker-compose.yml JWT secrets fail closed (empty when unset) without published default secrets, align signer and verifier resolution chains to use service-specific variable falling back to shared PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_JWT_SECRET, document explicit secret in .env.example, fix test_stage_promotion_compose.py expectations to match canonical fail-closed compose and consolidated deploy helper, assert no literal defaults in compose JWT secrets, and verify rendered compose for dev profiles in both unset and supplied states.

acceptance_criteria.ac1_fail_closed: No service in docker-compose.yml verifies or signs JWTs with a published default secret; all 8 JWT secrets across all services (TRAINING_SESSION_JWT_SECRET, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_JWT_SECRET, PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_JWT_SECRET, PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_JWT_SECRET, PANTHEON_BFF_JWT_SECRET, PANTHEON_CAPITAL_JWT_SECRET, PANTHEON_REGISTRY_JWT_SECRET, PERSONA_JWT_SECRET, PANTHEON_MEMORY_JWT_SECRET, CAPITAL_JWT_SECRET, PANTHEON_DEPLOYMENT_JWT_SECRET) resolve only from explicit environment or the shared dev secret PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_JWT_SECRET, and are empty (fail closed) when unset.
acceptance_criteria.ac2_env_example: Local full-stack reproduction that needs the secret gets it from explicit environment documented in .env.example; nothing in the repository supplies a usable default JWT secret.
acceptance_criteria.ac3_test_passed: services/runtime-manager/test_stage_promotion_compose.py passes (4 passed); the deploy canary test checks that every rollout path in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh goes through with_dev_bff_runtime_env and that the helper sets PANTHEON_CANARY_EXECUTION_ENABLED=false; test_compose_jwt_secrets_fail_closed_without_literal_defaults asserts that all compose JWT secrets fail closed without literal defaults.
acceptance_criteria.ac4_deciding_commits_classified: Each changed test expectation is classified in the evidence with its deciding commit (442327f5b added the published default and a4dcf76ce consolidated the deploy environment into the shared helper).
acceptance_criteria.ac5_rendered_compose_dev_profiles: Rendered compose for the dev profiles shows all 14 JWT secret instances across all services resolve to empty string when unset (fail closed) and to the supplied secret when PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_JWT_SECRET is set as the deploy does, with secrets redacted.

test_dev_compose_wires_shared_jwt_verifi.decision: Commit 442327f5b introduced a fallback to a published default secret (pantheon-local-governance-jwt-secret) in docker-compose.yml for governance and operator-bff. All compose JWT secrets are now made fail-closed (${VAR:-${PANTHEON_DEV_BFF_JWT_SECRET:-}}). The test expectation was updated to assert canonical fail-closed expressions without published defaults.

test_dev_deploy_script_explicitly_keeps_.decision: Commit a4dcf76ce consolidated the dev deployment runtime environment into the shared with_dev_bff_runtime_env helper, eliminating duplicate inline environment exports and leaving exactly 1 occurrence of PANTHEON_CANARY_EXECUTION_ENABLED=false in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh. The test was updated to verify that with_dev_bff_runtime_env explicitly sets PANTHEON_CANARY_EXECUTION_ENABLED=false and that each dev rollout path (root and bff) executes through with_dev_bff_runtime_env.

test_compose_jwt_secrets_fail_closed_wit.decision: Added regression assertion to ensure all *_JWT_SECRET environment variables across all services in docker-compose.yml fail closed with empty defaults (':-') and do not contain literal default secrets (such as published 'pantheon-local-*' credentials).

follow_up_non_jwt_service_tokens.description: Out of scope for DEV-COMPOSE-JWT-FAIL-CLOSED-20261008 (which focuses on JWT secrets), but tracked for future fail-closed hardening of non-JWT service bearer tokens across docker-compose.yml.
